description_en: You can invoke ListLegacyAgentStatusLogs to obtain the list of legacy agent status logs for version 1.0. This API is available only to specific Users, and other Customers are not recommended to invoke it
description_zh: 调用ListLegacyAgentStatusLogs获取1.0遗留坐席状态日志列表，该接口仅对特定用户开放，其他客户不建议调用
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-legacy-agent-status-logs --instance-id ccc-test --page-number 1 --page-size 100 --start-time 1657778840011 --end-time 1657879880010 --agent-id agent@ccc-test --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListLegacyAgentStatusLogs

parameters.help_en: Start Time, in UNIX timestamp format, in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: End time, in Unix timestamp format, in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: Filter by agent ID. This parameter is optional and defaults to empty. An empty value means no filtering is applied
parameters.help_zh: 按坐席ID过滤，非必填，默认为空，为空表示不过滤
parameters.name: agent_id
